title: Copilot Studio & Agents Watch
blurb: A running record of the Microsoft Learn pages behind Microsoft Copilot Studio agents — the agent analytics and agent-evaluation surface that measures agent quality, cost-savings and consumption; the admin governance controls (DLP, transcript and sharing controls, agent inventory); and agent data residency. These are the sources the Hub's Agent Evaluator, Studio Agents, and ESS Insights reports depend on. Copilot Studio licensing, message-pack pricing and quota economics are tracked in the Pricing & Licensing Watch.
scopeNote: Scope: agent analytics, evaluation, governance and residency. Copilot Studio pricing, licensing and message/quota economics are tracked in the Pricing & Licensing Watch.
